source_admission: Full eligible training coverage of the five supported source configurations. Other researched repositories need explicit adapters and provenance checks before new phases.
completion: Twenty complete passes over every eligible deduplicated training reference from supported pinned source configurations, followed by held-out evaluation. No early stopping before the requested coverage.
volume_reporting: Unique source audio bytes and full-recording duration are reported separately from four-second crops actually presented to the model.
architecture: Saved XLS-R waveform encoder plus zero-initialized learned multi-resolution STFT residual head
